terms_of_use.title: Terms of Use
terms_of_use.object_body: These Terms of Use define the rules and conditions for using the LaundryMap application, published by EC2E, as well as the rights and obligations of users.
terms_of_use.editor_body: LaundryMap is published by EC2E, ZAC du Pont des Rayons, 4 boulevard Napoléon 1er, 95290 L'Isle-Adam, France. Email: contact@ec2e.com. Phone: +33 (0)1 83 02 02 02.
terms_of_use.access_body: Access to LaundryMap is free of charge. Searching for laundries and viewing their listings is available without creating an account. An account is required to post a review, add a laundry to favorites, or manage content. Sign-up can be done with an email address or via a Google account.
terms_of_use.accounts_body: Three types of accounts exist: the user account (searching for laundries, posting reviews, managing favorites), the professional account (creating and managing laundry listings, replying to reviews, in addition to user account features), and the administrator account (managing and moderating the platform).
terms_of_use.content_body: Users remain owners of the content they publish (reviews, comments, photos). By publishing it, they grant EC2E permission to host, store, and display it to other users as part of the service's operation.
terms_of_use.liability_body: Professionals are responsible for the information they publish about their establishments. EC2E does not guarantee the accuracy of information published by users or professionals, particularly opening hours or laundry descriptions, although requests to create laundry listings may be subject to manual review before publication.
terms_of_use.conduct_body: Users agree not to publish abusive, hateful, defamatory, or discriminatory content; not to harass or threaten other users; not to send spam or unauthorized advertising; not to post fake reviews; not to impersonate a third party; and not to publish illegal content. Comments containing words prohibited by administrators may be automatically blocked.
terms_of_use.moderation_body: Administrators may edit or delete a review, delete a comment, delete a laundry listing, or suspend or ban a user account in the event of non-compliance with these Terms of Use.
terms_of_use.reports_body: Users can report content. Reported content is not automatically removed: it is automatically hidden once it reaches 10 reports, and then reviewed by an administrator, who may decide to permanently delete it.
terms_of_use.deletion_body: Users can delete their account at any time from the profile edit page. Administrators may also suspend or delete an account in the event of non-compliance with these Terms of Use, particularly in cases of spam, abusive behavior, or inappropriate content.
terms_of_use.availability_body: The service is provided "as is", with no guarantee of permanent availability. EC2E reserves the right to temporarily or permanently suspend access to all or part of the service for maintenance or technical evolution purposes.
terms_of_use.intellectual_property_body: The name "LaundryMap", the logo, and all graphic, structural, and technical elements of the application are the exclusive property of EC2E. Any reproduction, representation, modification, or use, in whole or in part, without prior authorization is prohibited.
terms_of_use.data_protection_body: Use of the service involves the collection and processing of personal data in accordance with the Privacy Policy available within the application.
terms_of_use.governing_law_body: These Terms of Use are governed by French law. Any dispute relating to their interpretation or performance falls under the jurisdiction of French courts.

privacy_policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_policy.controller_body: EC2E, whose registered office is located at ZAC du Pont des Rayons, 4 boulevard Napoléon 1er, 95290 L'Isle-Adam, is responsible for processing personal data collected through the use of the LaundryMap application. For any question regarding data protection: contact@ec2e.com or dpo@ec2e.com. Phone: +33 (0)1 83 02 02 02.
privacy_policy.service_presentation_body: LaundryMap is an application for listing and searching laundromats across France. Users can browse listed laundries, post reviews, leave comments, save favorites, and, for professional accounts, create and manage laundry listings.
privacy_policy.data_collected_body: When creating an account, we collect: last name, first name, email address, phone number, profile picture, password (stored in hashed form), account creation date, and last login date. For professional accounts: company name, SIREN number, registered office address. We also record published reviews and comments, submitted reports, favorited laundries, and technical logs necessary for the service's security. If you authorize it, your geographic location may be used to search for nearby laundries; it is not stored in our database.
privacy_policy.purposes_body: Data is collected in order to create and manage user accounts, enable authentication, provide the application's features, manage reviews, comments, and reports, ensure platform security, prevent abuse, and respond to support requests.
privacy_policy.legal_basis_body: Processing is based on the performance of the contract between the user and LaundryMap, on EC2E's legitimate interest in ensuring the security and proper functioning of the application, and on the user's consent when they authorize access to their location.
privacy_policy.recipients_body: Personal data is accessible only to authorized platform administrators and to staff responsible for technical maintenance when necessary. When a user chooses to sign in with Google, authentication is delegated to Google LLC (Google OAuth); only the email address, first name, and last name are then transmitted to LaundryMap, with no password involved. No personal data is sold or transferred to third parties for commercial purposes.
privacy_policy.retention_body: Personal data is kept for as long as necessary to provide the service and comply with applicable legal obligations. Accounts marked as deleted may be temporarily retained for technical or security purposes. Technical logs are kept only for as long as necessary for security and maintenance purposes.
privacy_policy.security_body: EC2E implements technical and organizational measures to protect personal data: HTTPS connections, password hashing, secure token-based authentication, restricted administrator access, and logging of sensitive actions.
privacy_policy.local_storage_body: LaundryMap does not use any audience measurement or advertising tracking tool. Some information is stored locally on your device via your browser's Local Storage, in order to maintain your session and remember your preferences (language, theme). This information is used solely for the operation of the service. See our Cookies page for more details.
privacy_policy.rights_body: Under applicable regulations, you have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict the processing of, object to, and port your data. To exercise these rights, contact dpo@ec2e.com. A response will be provided within the timeframes set by applicable regulations.
privacy_policy.complaint_body: If you believe your rights are not being respected, you can file a complaint with the CNIL (www.cnil.fr).
privacy_policy.changes_body: This privacy policy may be amended at any time to reflect legal, regulatory, or technical changes to the service.

cookies_policy.title: Cookies
cookies_policy.no_cookies_body: LaundryMap does not use any cookies, whether for tracking, audience measurement, or advertising purposes. No cookie consent banner is therefore required on our application.
cookies_policy.local_storage_body: To function properly, LaundryMap uses your browser's Local Storage (not cookies) to keep you signed in and remember your display preferences, such as language or light/dark theme. This data stays stored on your device and is never transmitted to third parties.
cookies_policy.no_tracking_body: We do not use any audience analytics tool (such as Google Analytics) or any advertising pixel or tracker. Your browsing activity on LaundryMap is not tracked by third parties for commercial or statistical purposes.
cookies_policy.browser_settings_body: Since LaundryMap does not set cookies, no special action is required on your part. You can, however, view or clear the data stored locally by your browser (Local Storage) at any time from your browser settings; doing so will sign you out and reset your preferences.
cookies_policy.contact_body: For any question about this policy, you can contact us at contact@ec2e.com.

accessibility_page.title: Accessibility
accessibility_page.commitment_body: EC2E strives to make LaundryMap accessible to as many people as possible, including people with disabilities, by following the good practices of the French accessibility guidelines (RGAA) and WCAG standards. This is an ongoing, progressive effort.
accessibility_page.implemented_body: A light theme and a dark theme with adapted color contrasts to improve readability. A page structure based on semantic landmarks (header, navigation, footer) to make reading easier for assistive technologies. Native buttons and links, rather than plain clickable elements, so they are properly recognized by screen readers and usable with the keyboard. Visible focus indicators on interactive elements to support keyboard navigation. Labels associated with form fields, along with aria-label attributes on icon buttons without visible text. Alternative text on informative images, and the aria-hidden attribute on purely decorative images. Keyboard navigation support (Enter and Space keys) on key interactive elements, such as laundry listing cards.
accessibility_page.known_limitations_item_1: Some modal dialogs do not yet implement a focus trap, which can make keyboard navigation more difficult.
accessibility_page.known_limitations_item_2: The page's language attribute does not yet update automatically when switching languages in the application.
accessibility_page.known_limitations_item_3: A "skip to content" link is not yet available at the top of each page.
accessibility_page.contact_body: If you encounter an accessibility issue on LaundryMap, please let us know at contact@ec2e.com so we can review and improve it.
